goal: Prevent BIP 157 light clients from disconnecting or banning Core nodes when requesting new blocks
Core currently ignores filter requests for announced blocks if the filter index has not yet caught up
agreement: Strong support for deferring racing filter requests in net_processing to prevent disconnects (mzumsande)
Supports handling the issue because slow filter calculations cause frequent races with peers (ajtowns)
Past concerns about index coupling and request handling were resolved (sedited, ajtowns, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a protocol violation causing light clients like Neutrino to disconnect or ban nodes
Filter generation frequently races block announcements, causing dropped responses for valid blocks
